name: r6-mut-fixed-snapshot-collation
description: Mutation triage (same class as zone-schedule/lifecycle-collation): push.js fixedScheduleSnapshot sorts the fixed transition's source_schedule_snapshot with String(a.schedule_uuid).localeCompare(...). Go sorted by bytes, so the first Gen2 clock acknowledgement stored the snapshot in another order when schedule ids differ only in case or in '_' against '-'. 07I-gen2-fixed-transition with four weekly schedules.

steps.why: devices discovered and claimed before the session, as in the release smoke

Weekly schedules whose schedule_uuid order differs between ICU's localeCompare and byte order: a pair equal but for case (ICU puts lower case first) and a pair that differs in '_' against '-' (ICU sorts '_' first).
